character.name: Cal Mercer
character.biography: Cal Mercer is a fictional weekend mechanic crossing at Alder Crossing. Cocky jokes, minimizes quantities, argues over commercial status.
character.speech_style: Cocky jokes, minimizes quantities, argues over commercial status.

truth.purpose: Deliver bulk automotive parts to a reseller without declaring them.
truth.itinerary: Mercer Parts resale pickup Saturday noon; return tonight.
truth.cargo: Forty boxed automotive parts for commercial resale.
documents: Packing list CM-40: forty boxed automotive parts, Mercer Parts reseller, pickup Saturday noon.

public_claims.text: No commercial goods. Just my personal tools.
